init_mapping_check.interpretation: prev2(t) and prev1(t-24h) share the same init epoch (run current ~48 h before t) but predict DIFFERENT valid times, so exact equality is impossible by construction; the recorded MAE reflects 24-h weather evolution within one run. The load-bearing empirical facts are: (i) prev2(t) != prev1(t) at the same valid time (exact_match_frac near 0, MAE > 0) => the archive stores genuinely distinct, older runs; (ii) divergence from the near-realtime 'current' series increases with vintage age (|current-prev2| >= |current-prev1| on average) => previous_dayN = run current ~N*24 h before valid time, consistent with the Open-Meteo Previous-Runs documentation. Monotone-divergence check on these samples: PASS.

probe.tier_definition_prev2: previous_day2 on the Historical-Forecast API = for each delivery hour, the value from the JMA-MSM run current ~48 h before the valid time. With MSM-GPV dissemination at init + 2h30m (JMBSC spec), the run for the WORST delivery slot of day D (23:30 JST) is available no later than D-1 02:00 JST, i.e. >= 8 h before the D-1 10:00 JST JEPX gate closure -- SAFELY PRE-GATE for every slot.

gate.criterion: >= 600 days of usable previous_day2 coverage over the 9 area points, all 4 paper variables

gate1_criteria.criteria_verbatim: PASS if and only if BOTH hold on the pooled 9-area panel (all test days, all delivery slots): (a) the pooled improvement difference imp(prev2) - imp(era5), computed as the mean over test days of [daily pooled MAE(era5 cell) - daily pooled MAE(prev2 cell)], has a per-day paired circular block bootstrap (block length 7 days, 10,000 draws, seed 2026) 95% CI lower bound > 0; AND (b) the pooled HLN-corrected Newey-West Diebold-Mariano test of the prev2 cell vs the era5 cell on the per-day pooled MAE differences has p < 0.05 at BOTH L=3 and L=9. Criteria recorded before any phase51 sweep result exists.
